design_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism meets Broadcast Control Room. The UI must feel like a high-performance Human-Machine Interface (HMI). Actionable clarity over decoration. Bootstrap-familiar structure (grids, striped tables) elevated with modern typography and sharp contrasts.

typography.setup_instruction: Add IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts in index.html.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_structure: Sidebar (w-64, bg-slate-900 text-white) + Top Header (h-16, white bg, border-b) + Main Content (p-4 sm:p-6 bg-slate-50).
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Dense layout, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children only.
layout_and_spacing.kiosk_layout: Single-screen centered layout for Store Receiver. Massive Typography. No scrolling. Use flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Sharp and crisp. Use rounded-md (4px-6px max) for cards and buttons. 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) for all cards.

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm. No glassmorphism.
components.tables: Bootstrap-style. Dense spacing (py-2 px-3). text-sm. Striped rows (even:bg-slate-50). Left-aligned text, fixed sticky headers (bg-white border-b-2 border-slate-200).

buttons.primary: bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300
buttons.emergency_stop: h-24 sm:h-32 w-full text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-bold bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-lg shadow-md border border-red-800 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center justify-center gap-4 transition-all

components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold border. Crisp contrast.
components.live_indicator: Red dot with absolute animate-pulse ring, text-red-600 font-bold.

login_kiosk_background.description: Abstract sound wave background for Login and Kiosk screens. Use with a heavy overlay (e.g., bg-slate-900/80) to ensure text legibility.

store_context_image.description: Clean retail store interior. Can be used as a subtle sidebar bottom image or placeholder if store images are needed.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles), key informational elements (status badges, timer, specific table rows), and major containers MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML+Tailwind for complex layouts, wrapping Shadcn primitives inside.
Build the dashboard using a Sidebar (left) + Topbar (right) layout pattern. Mobile responsive with hamburger menu.
The 'Emergency Stop' button must be visually dominant on the Broadcast Console.
Store Receiver page must be a separate route (e.g., /receiver) that acts as a full-screen kiosk. It requires an 'Enable Audio' interaction to bypass browser autoplay policies.
For the Receiver Status grid, use tight cards showing store name, location, and a color-coded status badge.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Strictly setup IBM Plex Sans and Mono in index.css.
Ensure the timer has a distinct monospaced font so the numbers don't jitter while ticking.
All React files must be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx.
